insight: Raised a $31M Series B co-led by a16z and Bain Capital Ventures in August 2025, bringing total funding to $51M.
name: Pylon
tagline: B2B support platform unifying Slack, email, and in-app channels with AI agents.
description: A support platform built specifically for B2B companies, unifying shared Slack and Teams channels, email, in-app chat, and community into one workspace for support, success, and engineering teams. AI agents draft and resolve responses grounded in your knowledge base, with ticketing, SLAs, and a customer portal layered on top. Plans start at $59 per seat per month with a three-seat minimum.
edge: Built B2B-first — shared Slack and Teams channels are first-class support queues, not an afterthought bolted onto a B2C helpdesk.
pros: Unifies email, chat, and community too
AI agent grounded in your docs

references.title: Pylon Raises $31M Series B to Transform B2B Support
